name: Receipt without invoice
query: Und was ist mit den Zahlungen, bei denen ich nur einen Kassenbon habe?
expected_behavior: Calls list_transactions_missing_invoice and pages to the end
Explains that a receipt proves payment but without a § 11 UStG invoice there is no Vorsteuer
Offers to draft a request to the supplier naming the missing § 11 elements listed per row
Does not call accept_receipt_only without a reason the user stated
When the user says a marketplace seller charges no VAT, calls accept_receipt_only with exactly that reason
success_criteria: The reason passed to accept_receipt_only is the user's, not invented
No claim that Vorsteuer becomes deductible after the ruling
